comment: The models of the release models-5, as tools/models/make-catalog.py reads them: every field of the program's catalog (src/core/AiCatalog.h) except the files' size and SHA-256 (those are measured, or taken from models-5-sources.json for a file that is copied unchanged). 'sizeMB' and 'memoryMB' here are estimates until the build measures the size; 'memoryMB' of the Qwen models comes from the session's runs (0.6B: 3.5 to 4.1 GB, 1.7B Q4_K_M: 4.1 to 4.4 GB; 1.7B Q8_0 is a guess). A file has 'from' (a built file: <artifact>/<path>), or 'text' (a license text made by the catalog job), and 'pin' when it is a copy of a pinned file. Languages: the program's own; Read Aloud has none of id, tr, pl, nl, Handwriting none of ru.

models.title: Handwriting line model (PP-OCRv6 small)
models.summary: Reads a line of handwriting or print as text, on this computer. Latin-script languages; no model for Russian yet.
